title: Analysis by the Polarization of the Physic-Chemical Processes in the Friction Pairs, What It Works with Selective Transfer
content: Based on some experiments, the paper describes with the help of polarization the physic-chemical processes that take place in the contact area of friction pairs (of type bronze/steel lubricated with glycerin), during the selective transfer as a result of the change in the input speed of the lubricant (glycerin), as well as how it their wear influences. Through the polarization method, the quantitative and qualitative transformations of glycerin are studied during frictional stress with the selective transfer as well as the damage to the metals and alloys of the friction pairs, even after frictional stress, respectively can be determined the properties of the selective solution.
